votes.motion: MOVED TO APPROVE THE MINUTES AS PRESENTED. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER LOPEZ,
MOVED THE PUBLIC HEARING BE CLOSED. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER HYER,

ON A MOTION BY COUNCIL MEMBER HYER AND SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER BLAIR, ORDINANCE WAS PASSED AND ADOPTED AS OGDEN CITY ORDINANCE 2023-70 AND ORDERED POSTED AS REQUIRED BY LAW [ENTITLED: "An ordinance of Ogden City Utah vacating a portion of the 3rd Street right-of-way between porter avenue and Jefferson avenue; quit claiming the property within the vacated portion of said street to the abutting property owners as their interests may appear; reserving a right-of-way for all utilities that may now exist in said portion of such street; directing the City Recorder to record this ordinance in the office of the County Recorder; and providing that this ordinance shall become effective immediately upon posting after final passage."]
votes.subject: An ordinance of Ogden City Utah vacating a portion of the 3rd Street right-of-way between porter avenue and Jefferson avenue; quit claiming the property within the vacated portion of said street to the abutting property owners as their interests may appear; reserving a right-of-way for all utilities that may now exist in said portion of such street; directing the City Recorder to record this ordinance in the office of the County Recorder; and providing that this ordinance shall become effective immediately upon posting after final passage.
